title: 目標達成の後に・我等が目指すは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring season of the classic G1 races is finally on the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And as for how Mejiro Ardan is coping during this period of high tensions…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Phew. Trainer, how was my time?
choice_data_list: You've topped your personal best again.
You've topped your personal best again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I suppose that's yet another goal achieved successfully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan has been steadily accumulating both experience and strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this rate, she'll be able to set her sights even higher. She must know that herself too. Perhaps, now…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'd like to discuss something with you.
choice_data_list: I had a feeling you would.
I had a feeling you would.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Shall we speak elsewhere?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Concerning the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Would it be presumptuous of me to make winning such a prestigious race my next goal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With eyes harboring a determination fiercer than ever, Mejiro Ardan poses this question seconds after we step into my office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …As you might know, my older sister, Mejiro Ramonu, is the first-ever Triple Tiara holder, and is reputed as the "crown jewel of the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And, as her younger sibling, I have always been outshone by her brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I wish to be free of her shadow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't wish for acclaim as "Mejiro Ramonu's little sister"…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I hope to shine forth myself—as Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: One day, I wish to radiate such brilliant light that it eclipses that of my sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As such… I'd like to accomplish something she didn't—leave a mark on the Classic Triple Crown tour.
choice_data_list: Can I ask you why you've decided on the Japanese Derby?
Can I ask you why you've decided on the Japanese Derby?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Primarily… because of my body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Though it pains me to admit it… in the event that I run in all of the Triple Crown races, my body will surely be subject to a level of strain I've never experienced before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm concerned that if I ran in all three, I would inevitably come up short in each.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I'd rather focus my efforts on one. I'll make my name at the Japanese Derby—the race heralded by all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Of course, if you believe that I'm capable of running in all three races, then I shall defer to your judgment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But my desire remains the same—to run in the Japanese Derby. I would appreciate your understanding in this matter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So then… what do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'm with you on this one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You are?
choice_data_list: Let's shoot for the Japanese Derby.
Let's shoot for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Ardan's classic year before us, her path to eternal glory comes to light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ahead lies the race of countless Umamusume's dreams… The Japanese Derby—a fleeting, once-in-a-lifetime shot to seize the everlasting title of Derby Champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's an inevitable step towards Ardan's future. I would have suggested it myself, had she not.
choice_data_list: Given who you are now, I know you can do it.
Given who you are now, I know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm truly happy that you believe in me.
choice_data_list: For now, let's aim for the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I support her decision to focus on the Derby, it'd be haphazard to tackle that race without a run-up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It'd be best to set a mid-term goal for her to get more experience. That should help increase her chances of winning the Derby, if only by a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since the Aoba Sho is held at the same racecourse as the Japanese Derby, it'll serve as an excellent preliminary race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of that, with it being a G2 race, it'll probably put less strain on Ardan's body than a Triple Crown G1 event. Essentially, if we're going to set a goal for the near future, the Aoba Sho should be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Understood. …It appears that I shall have to work even harder as we move forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To embark together for a grand, lofty dream… My heart soars in a way I never knew possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Ardan and I take our first step on our journey to the biggest battle of her classic year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …This isn't enough. I need to step up…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've realized something over the course of the races I've run. There are people out there whose strength goes far beyond my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And compared to them, I'm still so green. Mentally, technically, and physically… I lack in all areas.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …That said, I've no intention of losing any momentum whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I chose to race in the hopes of squaring off against mighty foes. The power I yearn for lies on the other side of hard-fought victories!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As such… the Classic Triple Crown will be mine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No matter how strong the competition, I'll not be bested by anybody. Not Ardan, not Chiyono O…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll not lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …What a lovely sunset.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My results during my junior year were great for boosting my confidence.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: While reflecting on how well I'd done, I found myself thinking—for just a moment—that winning the Japanese Derby might be possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And yet…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Ngh. My rate of acceleration is still too slow. I must visualize my maximum speed earlier!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I wish to run another lap!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan looks really pumped today…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Even after all that success in her junior year, she still wants to achieve more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Unlike me, she never settles for less. She brings everything she has to every single training session.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …I'm never going to win like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm such an idiot! I can't afford to sit around feeling complacent! I have to…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have to push myself to my limits.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: After all… I want to win the Japanese Derby too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win… because I want to stand beside them as equals!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Today's drops of sweat will become tomorrow's tears of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I've no doubt that the Japanese Derby will feature the fiercest competition I have ever faced.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Especially…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Chiyono O and Yaeno.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Their feats have been particularly eye-opening. Even in the Japanese Derby, I expect they will prove to be my toughest opponents…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —No, that's not the case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I must remember that which I'm seeking to overcome now.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The crown jewel looming over my head, whose splendor casts an undying shadow over me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Regardless of whom I'm facing, I must first concentrate on completing the race myself.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Then, naturally, the results will follow.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The Aoba Sho… I must focus on the present, and improve myself for the race before me.
